data.name: Mufizah
data.gender_notes: Mufizah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Mufizah means 'she who preserves, protects, or saves'. This name carries a deep spiritual significance in Islam, representing the concept of safeguarding one's faith and values. The name Mufizah carries the meaning “Preserver, Protector” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mufizah usually hope their child will grow to embody preserver, protector and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes protection, preservation, and safeguarding one's faith in Islam.
data.etymology: Mufizah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Preserver, Protector.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mufizah total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

data.cultural_impact: The name Mufizah holds great cultural significance in the Islamic world as it is associated with the idea of preservation, protection, and saving. This can be interpreted in various ways, such as protecting one's family, community, or even the Islamic faith itself. In Islamic history, there are numerous examples of individuals who were known as Mufizah, such as those who protected mosques, preserved Islamic texts, or safeguarded the faith during times of persecution.
data.spiritual_significance: Moreover, the spiritual significance of this name is deeply rooted in the Islamic belief that every Muslim is responsible for preserving their faith and spiritual wellbeing. By carrying the name Mufizah, one is reminded of this responsibility and is inspired to strive towards protecting their soul from the temptations and distractions of the material world. It is also considered a reminder of the role of Allah as the ultimate Mufiz, who preserves and protects His creation and guides them towards the right path.
